GifOS inlines classic scripts and drops type=module. Upstream examples load
jQuery from cdnjs and send Google Analytics pageviews — those are stripped.
C3 / D3 / Google chart renderers are not shipped. The last CSV and the last
pivot arrangement are saved privately. Upstream has no save.
